payload.body: You tend to idealize someone who seems more honest, free, creative, or less restrained than you allow yourself to be. Their flaws get explained away until the difference between the imagined person and the real one becomes impossible to ignore. Underneath is often a desire that felt safer when it belonged to somebody else. Name what you wanted from the image before deciding what the person failed to provide.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite Neptune can make another person seem to hold a freedom or desire you have not admitted wanting yourself.
